critique: The split-screen diptych creates a striking cyber-organic contrast, seamlessly embedding glowing, procedurally drawn canvas salamanders within shifting pointillist dot grids of cool blue-golds and warm fiery oranges. However, the floating guinea pig PNG and reliance on a missing external background video feel like unresolved afterthoughts that disrupt the otherwise cohesive interplay of layered SVG geometry and pulsing code-based elements.
